artist.title: Who You Are
artist.blurb: The basics, in your own words. This is the first thing a new listener learns about you.
artist.why: It becomes your first docu-slice and the opening line of every card, poster and intro that carries your name.
artist.familyTie: Write one line a stranger could read on any of our family pages: WaveWarZ, Wave ID, Wave Station or the ZAO.

prompts.label: Who are you in one sentence?
prompts.hint: A stranger should get you from this line alone.

prompts.label: What music do you make, and what makes it yours?
Your short bio: 3 or 4 sentences you would be proud to see on every platform.
What do you want right now, with your music?
What are you trying to prove, to yourself or anyone else?
What is your greatest strength as an artist?

checklist.label: What you want and what you are proving written

artist.skipOk: Long bio, core belief and archetype can wait. Candy can suggest an archetype with you later.

artist.title: Your Look
artist.blurb: Colors, logo, symbol and the full character: the look, the costume, the stage presence.
artist.why: Every poster, Face-Off card and clip uses these. Once they are set, nobody has to ask you again.
artist.familyTie: Send your logo as a clean file. The same file travels to WaveWarZ, Wave Station and ZAO pages.

prompts.label: Your signature color, a second color and an accent (names or hex codes).
Do you have a symbol, monogram or mark? If not, what would it be?
Your full character: the look, the costume, the stage presence. Describe it like a movie character.
Any signature visual effect or style you love (grain, glitch, neon, hand-drawn)?
What should we never do to your image?

collect: Your logo as a PNG with a transparent background, if you have one
3 to 5 of your best photos, full resolution
A reference for your costume or character, if there is one
artist.skipOk: No logo yet? Say so and we will plan one. Do not rush it.

artist.title: Your Story, In Your Own Words
artist.blurb: Short answers recorded once, each as its own clip. We stack them into interviews, docu-slices and flashbacks.
artist.why: Every cut we make later (the interview, the pre-battle slice, the flashback) is built from these blocks, so a plain answer today becomes episodes later.
artist.familyTie: Mention where we found each other: Wave Wars, the ZAO, a festival, a Space. These are the threads that make the history real.

prompts.label: Core answer 1: What music do you play?
prompts.hint: Record it as its own 30 to 60 second clip. It must make sense without any other clip.

prompts.label: Core answer 2: How long have you been playing?
Core answer 3: Where did you grow up?
Your picks: which of these do you want the world to see? History, hobbies, what you are working on now, anything else you choose.
Docu-slice plan: what would you share, in order? Basics, childhood, training, free time, then your pick.
Got an idea for a meme promo or a funny short about yourself? Describe it.

collect: 3 core answers, each recorded as its own short clip
At least 1 block of your choice (history, hobbies, current work)
Any older footage that tells part of your story (we credit third-party creators with simple text)

checklist.label: At least 1 of your own picks recorded

artist.skipOk: Anything personal you are not comfortable sharing stays out. You choose what the world sees.

artist.title: Your Music and Best Videos
artist.blurb: The songs you would battle with, and your best videos.
artist.why: Your music is the reason anyone clicks. Having the right songs and links ready makes every battle and clip faster to produce.
artist.familyTie: Songs can be listed for Wave Station when it opens. Note which tracks you own fully so we know what is free to feature.

prompts.label: Which 3 to 5 songs would you battle with? Add the links (Audius or elsewhere).
Which 2 or 3 videos show you at your best? Add links.
Any live performance footage? Where is it?
Do you own these tracks fully, or is anyone else involved? (Producers, features, samples.)

artist.skipOk: If you are unsure about ownership on a track, flag it. We will not feature it until it is clear.

artist.title: Your Voice and Lines
artist.blurb: Catchphrases and how you talk about a battle: a winner and a loser, with the anger kept in the music.
artist.why: These are the lines clips and graphics quote. They become part of your recognizable voice.
artist.familyTie: Pick a line that works on any family stage, not only in a battle.

prompts.label: Your catchphrase.
What do you say when you win?
How do you challenge an opponent?
How do you sign off?
How would you describe your voice and tone?
Your signature weapon: bars, melody, production, storytelling, genre mixing?
What is fair game in a rivalry, and what is off limits?
What do you call your fans or community?

artist.skipOk: One strong catchphrase is enough to start.

artist.title: Your Entrance (THE WALK)
artist.blurb: The moment before your first song: the sound, the words and the beats of your entrance.
artist.why: The entrance is often the most shareable clip of any event. A ready entrance means every battle starts strong.
artist.familyTie: Tell us if your entrance can play at ZAO Festivals and other family stages too.

prompts.label: Is there a few-second sound or sting that should play when you enter? Link it.
How should the announcer introduce you? Write it the way you want to hear it.
Describe the beats of your entrance, step by step.

artist.skipOk: No sound yet? Write the intro first. We can find the sound together.

artist.title: Your Home Base
artist.blurb: The places people land when they look you up, set up so a new fan can binge you.
artist.why: When someone loves one artist, they go looking for the next. A polished home base turns a single listener into a binge listener.
artist.familyTie: Link your Wave ID, Wave Station page and ZAO profile where they apply, so the family finds you from anywhere.

prompts.label: Do you have a website? Link it, or note what you need.
Do you have a YouTube channel with your best videos on it? Link it.
Does the same bio appear on every platform? List the platforms.
Do your profile picture and cover image match across platforms?
Do your video thumbnails catch the eye? Share an example you like or are unsure about.

checklist.label: Profile picture and cover image match

artist.skipOk: Do these in batches. Tell us which one you need help with first.

artist.title: Your Community, Causes and Family
artist.blurb: Who you belong to, what you care about and which brands or causes genuinely fit you.
artist.why: Matching you with partners who truly fit is how we find the right fit later, without forcing it.
artist.familyTie: This is the family module. Note your connection to Wave ID, Wave Station, the ZAO and ZAO Festivals, and who you would want us to introduce you to.

prompts.label: Which communities are you part of?
Which kinds of brands, genres or causes genuinely fit you? (This is a wish list. Nothing is promised.)
Do you have merch, or an idea for it?
How are you connected to Wave ID, Wave Station, the ZAO or ZAO Festivals? Who should we introduce you to?

artist.skipOk: Leave anything blank that you are not sure about.

artist.title: Your Archive: History and Footage
artist.blurb: Older footage, press, photos from past shows and anything that tells your history.
artist.why: Old footage becomes flashbacks and era remixes: the same footage in a new context. Every item we keep needs a reason, and that reason is how it becomes part of WaveWarZ lore.
artist.familyTie: Footage from ZAO Festivals or other family events belongs here too. Tag which family stage it came from.

prompts.label: What older footage or photos do you have, and where are they?
Any press, interviews or features about you? Links.
What are the 3 moments from your career you would most want people to see?
Who filmed or made anything you are sharing, so we can credit them?

artist.skipOk: This module is ongoing. Share what you have and add more over time.

event.title: Announce and Set the Story
event.blurb: The battle is announced, the story is set and the artists are introduced.
event.why: A clear story before the battle is what makes people care about the result.
event.familyTie: Tell the family first: Wave ID, Wave Station and the ZAO should hear about it before the public.

event.title: Artist Interview and Docu-Slice
event.blurb: One new sliver of each artist, plus the countdown and sponsor moment.
event.why: Each battle teaches the audience a little more about the artists, which is why they come back.
event.familyTie: A family partner can own this segment. Mark which one if so.

event.title: Face-Off
event.blurb: The two sides meet before the battle. Fight Card, predictions and lock-in.
event.why: The Face-Off is where the rivalry becomes visible and the audience picks a side.
event.familyTie: Note where the Face-Off was held and whether a partner owns the arena.

event.title: Battle Night
event.blurb: The live battle: trailer, entrances and live data.
event.why: The live night produces the footage everything else is cut from.
event.familyTie: Mention which family members joined, spoke or sponsored.

event.title: Aftermath and Next Announcement
event.blurb: The result, the reactions, what it meant, and the next battle announced.
event.why: The announcement of the next battle is how the wheel keeps turning.
event.familyTie: Thank and tag the family partners who took part.

league.title: Identity and Ethos
league.blurb: What WaveWarZ is, in the words we all use: mission, one-liners, tagline and the ethos.
league.why: Everyone telling the same story is how a new audience understands us quickly.
league.familyTie: Write how Wave ID, Wave Station and the ZAO fit into this sentence.

checklist.label: Ethos written: all genres, all you, the audience decides

league.title: Rules, Scoring and Guardrails
league.blurb: Official battle rules, how winners are decided and the lines we do not cross.
league.why: Clear rules are what make the competition credible.
league.familyTie: Make sure family partners can explain the rules in one sentence.

league.title: Brand, Logos and Templates
league.blurb: Logos, brand guide, slogans and the reusable templates for flyers and cards.
league.why: Reusable brand pieces mean every new piece of content starts from a finished base.
league.familyTie: Include co-branding versions for Wave ID, Wave Station and the ZAO.

league.title: The Family: Wave ID, Wave Station, The ZAO and ZAO Festivals
league.blurb: The people and projects that are one team with WaveWarZ. Keep reaching out, keep including them.
league.why: They are part of the story. Recording each touchpoint keeps the relationship active and the history accurate.
league.familyTie: This module is the family itself.

checklist.label: Wave ID: introduction written and shared
Wave Station: introduction written and shared
The ZAO: introduction written and shared
ZAO Festivals: past and upcoming events recorded
Reached out to each this month

league.title: Sponsors and Segments
league.blurb: Spots in the battle cycle a partner can own, and the assets for each.
league.why: Fixed segments are repeatable and consistent, and they never get forgotten when things get busy.
league.familyTie: Family partners are offered a segment before outside brands.

checklist.label: Segments defined: Face-Off, Interview, Flyer, In-scene, Roll Call

league.title: Press, History and Charity
league.blurb: Milestones, press coverage and charity work.
league.why: This is the written history. A milestone saved today is a proof point tomorrow.
league.familyTie: Include family milestones such as ZAO Festivals and partner launches.

league.title: Records and Receipts
league.blurb: The Record Book and the receipts behind it.
league.why: Records give each battle weight. They turn a result into history.

league.title: Distribution Engine
league.blurb: Every channel the content goes out on, kept on a regular schedule.
league.why: Regular formats make a habit. Each channel feeds the others.
league.familyTie: List the family channels that carry our content too.

checklist.label: Method for saving Space audio set
